proposals.mechanism: Installed physical VoidUpgradeItem creates wrapper from same upgrade stack and live save callback. Legacy persistent boolean should_void_overflow is decoded through Codec.BOOL; true translates SLOT_OVERFLOW, false ALWAYS, legacy removed then guarded setVoidType persists canonical string enum and calls owner save callback. Constructor subsequently loads enum with defaultALWAYS and config clamp to SLOT_OVERFLOW when unconditional deletion disabled. The actual persistent upgrade handler writes same modified stack to same installed slot and serializes upgradeInventory before contentsSaveHandler. Actual InventoryHandler preinsert/slot-overflow/storage-overflow callbacks read restored policy and filter: ALWAYS accepts matching input by returningEMPTY, SLOT_OVERFLOW discards matching remainder with matching full slot, STORAGE_OVERFLOW waits until full matching slot plus no empty slot/no partial matching stack. Queued GUI deletion is separate transient set, not durable entitlement.
proposals.dedup: 0f40 promotes storage wrapper slot metadata, not destructive overflow semantics;25b6 restores filter/memory templates but does not specify when physically offered stock is deleted;d51 owns protected sorting exclusion rather than destruction,26f moves fixed attachment objects without bool→three-mode contract. Propose one whole concrete installed disposal-policy migration owner, not credit for single boolean/enum field, wrapper factory or per-mode variants. An enum conversion without actual insert/overflow consumption would be0. Await coordinator judgment whether this concrete policy owner is independently covered; no automatic main-ledger addition.
limits: Migration removes legacy component BEFORE setVoidType. If oldfalse→ALWAYS is prohibited by current config, setter returns without storing new VOID_TYPE or invoking save; constructor then loads existing current component/default and clamps runtime. Legacy marker removed in memory may not be explicitly persisted by this failed setter path. Do not claim atomic canonical rewrite for all cases.

When legacy and current both present, accepted legacy mapping overwrites current enum. Rejected legacyfalse leaves current enum authoritative. Normal read clamps runtime only and does not normalize stored ALWAYS, so later config enable can re-enable destructive mode.

Persistent enum CODEC is StringRepresentable.fromEnum; fromName unknown→ALWAYS is used menu packet parser, not proof disk codec has same fallback. Modern native DataComponentType persistence and invalid component handling not executed.

Returning EMPTY from simulation reports acceptance/disposal without mutating offered stack; void callbacks do not themselves shrink input. Real calling transfer relies on returned remainder contract. Inventory pipeline consumer traced, external automation/fakeplayer transfer protocols not deep audited.

Void wrapper full-stack overflow matching with strict component/durability settings consults full-stack index; relaxed matching also considers partial stacks in helper. Do not equate every relaxed match with one full matching slot, or claim all paths preserve last exemplar.

slotsToVoid holds only slot indices; tick extracts whatever is currently present without rechecking filter/mode/item identity. Slot replacement or policy change before execution can affect another stack. Queue is not persisted; external storage tick/GUI-slot notification dispatch not traced, so no guaranteed queued deletion continuity claim.

Filter underlying stack components/tags predicate internals not fully expanded; actual filter entry restoration/matching branch read. Fluid shouldVoidFluid consumer not expanded through every pump, fluid-specific behavior add0.

UpgradeHandler persistent=false or absent registry access can bypass real serialized write; actual contentsSaveHandler caller implementation/native disk flush not expanded for every owning backpack/barrel. No game/runtime transaction proof, no production patch.

No extra count for each component/mode, candidate/private helper or same-shaped owner elsewhere. Only one bounded proposal upper bound1; fixed source/client API version not treated as directly binary-compatible Dynasty implementation.
